title: Osmolyn
body: Osmolyn leaks from halite. It is the brine of the water, and the cell does not import it as fuel. Water richer than the middle of a plume draws water out of the cell. Water poorer than that pushes water in.

The Osmolyn Receptor, set in the membrane, reports how much brine is touching the cell. A conditional promoter can read that report. Osmoprotectin, made in the cytosol, limits how far rich water can shrivel the body. Aquaporin, also in the membrane, is the water channel: see Osmotic stress.
